note: Level 1 competencies. Topics come from LRP 1 (Pre-K1 themes, pages 11 to 13). Skills and learning areas come from LRP 2: pages 2 to 12 for 2-year-olds (Stage A), pages 13 to 35 for 3-year-olds (Stage B). Each 'area' is the LRP 2 domain the indicator is listed under.

source.ref: 3 years old, Self-Awareness 4: identify and express basic emotions such as happy, sad, afraid, angry, ashamed (2 years old: p.5, indicator 1). Topic: LRP 1 p.12, I Have Feelings
3 years old, Health, Safety and Self-Care 2: dressing up, wearing slippers and shoes. Topic: LRP 1 p.12, This Is What I Wear; I Have Things I Use for Sleeping and Playing

3 years old, Relationship with Familiar Adults 1.1: identify each one by name and his/her relations (2 years old: p.7, indicators 2 and 3). Topic: LRP 1 p.12, Father, Mother, Brother, Sister; Grandmother, Grandfather
3 years old, Health, Safety and Self-Care 6: identify and practice eating nutritious foods such as fruits and vegetables. Topic: LRP 1 p.12, What do I Eat

3 years old, Health, Safety and Self-Care 1: identify personal cleaning tools such as toothbrush, face towel (spoon and fork: p.16, Fine Motor 7). Topic: LRP 1 p.12, Things I Use in Eating; Things I Use When I Clean Myself
3 years old, Receptive and Expressive Language 1.1: imitate the sounds of different animals (2 years old: p.7, indicator 3, names of pets). Topic: LRP 1 p.12, There Are Wonderful Animals Around Us
3 years old, Receptive and Expressive Language 8.2: name familiar things found inside and outside the home. Topic: LRP 1 p.12, Products in Our Community
2 years old, Cognitive indicator 15: point to and name some body parts. Topic: LRP 1 pp.12-13, I Have My Two Eyes to See, Ears to Hear, Nose to Smell, Tongue to Taste
Pre-K1, God Created a Beautiful World for Us: What is the Weather? Is it Sunny or Rainy?; How do You Feel When It's Sunny, Cloudy or Rainy?; What do We do on a Stormy Weather?
3 years old, Cognitive 4.4: know that certain things are the same and can be substituted for each other
3 years old, Cognitive 4.5: state opposite relationships (big and small)
2 years old, Cognitive indicators 8 and 9: arrange objects according to colour; recognize and tell the colour
3 years old, Cognitive 2.2: group picture objects according to category (2 years old: p.8, indicator 8, according to function)
3 years old, Cognitive 2.5: understand the concept of number-quantity relations for 1-10 (p.24, 8.5: count 1 to 10; 2 years old p.8, indicator 9: number of one to three objects)
3 years old, Fine Motor Skills 2 and 3: eye-hand coordination; individual activity using manipulative tools. Puzzle play is a listed quiet activity in the ECCD Standards, p.28, 23
Cognitive indicator 8 (listed for 1 year old, continuing at 2): enjoy hide and seek or a game of searching for a toy (object permanence)

3 years old, Language 5: recognize sound patterns and repeat them such as clapping, stomping, patting (p.33, Creative 2.2: body movements with music; 2 years old p.10, Music 3 and 4: clap, bounce and dance; repeat an action at adult prompting)
